Third-party files used by the quick photo check on the captain page (runs on the captain's phone; nothing is uploaded).

  face-api.js                           browser bundle of @vladmandic/face-api 1.7.15 (includes TensorFlow.js), MIT licence — see LICENSE-face-api.txt
  models/tiny_face_detector_model.*     face detector weights, from the same package (model/)
  models/age_gender_model.*             age/gender estimator weights, from the same package (model/)

Source: npm registry, @vladmandic/face-api@1.7.15. The tarball's sha512 matched the registry's dist.integrity
(sha512-WDMmK3CfNLo8jylWqMoQgf4nIst3M0fzx1dnac96wv/dvMTN4DxC/Pq1DGtduDk1lktCamQ3MIDXFnvrdHTXDw==) before these files were taken from it.
The files are byte-for-byte copies; tests/web.test.js pins their sha256 so an accidental change is caught.
